Precision 0.085 (97 FPs, ~90/hour) and full-dive containment 0.0 (event_time anchors at the splash peak; pre-registered [t-8s,t+6s] window vs clip-extent GT) fail the 'rough clip containing the complete dive' half of the north star. Single-session corpus (PARTIAL) limits generalization.
deviations_from_initial_protocol: ALIGNMENT_VERIFIER_V2: v1 raw-thumbnail NCC matching is undiscriminating in the static pool scene (median NCC ~0.99; verified false peaks in empty segments). v2 uses temporal-derivative signature votes, offset clustering, path-score ranking, ambiguity margin, and a raw block-NCC floor. Registered before event-level evaluation; thresholds in protocol.py.

AUDIO_FUSION_IMPLEMENTATION_FIX: the onset score is one-sided, so full-series median/MAD degenerate to 0 and smoothing dilutes sparse transients ~5x. Robust stats taken over positive support; audio z rectified at 0; per-visual-bin max fusion without pre-smoothing. The pre-registered rule 'fusion = max of visual-z and audio-z' is preserved.
